summary: Nez Perce National Forest patrol tower of c.1934 (or a 1931 L-4 cabin); abandoned in the 1940s and now listed as gone, with dates in dispute.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; the Idaho lookout list marks it Tower Gone and Forest Lookouts says removed

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Hike-In.

events.note: 40-foot pole patrol tower, c.1934 per three pages
10-foot L-4 cabin per the Clearwater list and the 1981 Hartig history; may be a different structure from the 1934 tower
Clearwater list says last manned in the 1940s or 50s; decade only

evidence.supports: 40-foot pole patrol tower built in 1934; height 12.2 m
agency is the Nez Perce National Forest
page sections cover history and staff only, no site description
1981 Hartig history: L-4 cabin on a 10-foot log tower, 1931, Selway National Forest
evidence.quote: An L-4 cabin on a 10-foot high log tower was built on Barren Hill by the Selway National Forest in 1931 at a cost of $791.90.

evidence.supports: sources disagree on date and height
evidence.quote: NOTE: No two sources seem to agree on the date of construction and height of tower.

evidence.supports: Clearwater list gives a 10-foot L-4 cabin
Idaho lookout list marks it gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Nez Perce National Forest on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; the 1981 Hartig history quoted on Forest Lookouts names the Selway National Forest. The record keeps Nez Perce and the story reports both.
1934 for a 40-foot patrol tower (three pages) vs 1931 for a 10-foot L-4 cabin (Clearwater list and Hartig). Both are kept as events and reported in the story.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled June 2016)

notes_for_editor: Height 12.2 m (40 ft) rests on the 40-foot claims on three pages; the Clearwater list and the 1981 Hartig history say 10 feet. The record height is kept but is disputed. Build year (1934 vs 1931), agency (Nez Perce vs Selway) and last-manned date (1940s vs 1940s-50s) all disagree across sources. The 1931 event may describe a different structure from the 1934 tower. Hike-In is taken from the Idaho Fire Lookouts label.
